summary.text: Kannan Srinivasan is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 32.
The Senate biography lists Kannan Srinivasan's service in the House of Delegates from 2024 to 2025 and in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Kannan Srinivasan was born in Chennai, India, on August 24, 1966.
Kannan Srinivasan studied at Old Dominion University (MS) and the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (chartered accountant).
Kannan Srinivasan's listed occupation is management and finance consultant.
Kannan Srinivasan's listed memberships and affiliations include the George Washington Heart and Vascular Institute board in Washington, D.C. and the Loudoun Free Clinic board in Leesburg, Virginia.
The Senate page lists Kannan Srinivasan's committee assignments as Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources, Courts of Justice, Local Government, and Transportation.
